source: Recovered from GLC02414.341 (cipher) against GLC02414.114 (period decipherment written in the grid); all 36 cipher positions agree (scripts/check_341.py).

route.fill: message written row by row, six words to a row; first row is the heading: place, month, day, addressee, addressee's station, first word of text
route.indicator: first cipher word of each division is a commencement word, not part of the grid; rows = (words in division - 1) / 6

not_in_key: Meanings of any other code word are NOT part of the frozen key; they are reported as holes.
